messages:
Anya: quick note 1: rolling a tiny breaking tweak to SDK streaming: `for chunk in stream()` -> `for ev in stream().iter()` and events are typed (ev.type / ev.text). need docs snippets updated for py/ts/go.
Sam: i'll take python examples and tests. will replace `chunk['delta']` access.
Kim: TS on it. will update snippets and add a nock-based test that fakes streaming frames.
Matt: i'll update Go snippets and add an httptest-based unit test.
Anya: also changed default retry window (10s -> 5s). any examples that intentionally `sleep(12)` should be mocked or shortened. avoid real sleeps in docs tests.
Sam: Python draft snippet: ```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
for ev in client.stream('gpt-3.5', prompt='hi').iter():
    if ev.type == 'token':
        print(ev.text, end='')
    if ev.type == 'done':
        break
```
Kim: TS draft snippet: ```ts
import { StreamingClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new StreamingClient()
for await (const ev of c.stream('gpt-3.5',{prompt:'hi'}).iter()) {
  if (ev.type === 'token') process.stdout.write(ev.text)
  if (ev.type === 'done') break
}
```
Matt: Go draft snippet: ```go
cli := inference.NewStreamingClient(nil)
it := cli.Stream("gpt-3.5", inference.StreamOpts{Prompt:"hi"}).Iter()
for it.Next() {
  ev := it.Event()
  switch ev.Type {
  case inference.EventToken:
    fmt.Print(ev.Text)
  case inference.EventDone:
    break
  }
}
```
Anya: update migration note in docs/migration/sdk-streaming.md and change sidebar anchor from streaming-legacy -> streaming-iter.
docs-bot: PR checklist added: snippets, migration note, tests. deploy preview will show changes after CI passes.
Sam: splitting python commits: snippet change then tests. smaller diffs = faster reviews.
Kim: same plan for TS.
Matt: will add go README blurb: old->new example.
Anya: aim to land today. will add a one-release compat shim in SDK that logs deprecation when old raw loop used. closing thread.
